Desktop focus/reduced-chrome is observed; phone topology, tablet topology and exact responsive thresholds remain unknown. Document imagery, Style Gallery artwork, Imagine gradients and pricing illustrations are content, not application chrome. This is a review Candidate, not an Accepted Design Release.
